parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Colchicine is a chemical used by scientists to study mitosis. This chemical inhibits the organisation of the microtubules in prophase of mitosis.

The cell shown in Fig. 6.1 had **not** been treated with colchicine.

Explain the evidence in Fig. 6.1 that shows the cell had **not** been treated with colchicine.
